history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with messy black hair stands on a beach, looking down pensively. He is wearing a plain black t-shirt and striped shorts in shades of lavender and white. In his right hand, he holds a silver soda can and a cigarette. His left hand carries a pair of black flip-flops. The ocean stretches out behind him, with gentle waves rolling onto the shore and creating white foam. The sky is overcast and a muted grey, contributing to a slightly melancholic and calm atmosphere. The lighting is soft and diffused, typical of an overcast day. The color palette is dominated by muted blues, greys, and the black and white of the man's attire, with subtle hints of lavender in his shorts. The overall mood is introspective and serene.
